Dilli pulis ne suprim kort men kaha ki Jantar Mantar ek pradarshan sthal nahin, balki sarvajnik sarak hai. pulis ne sarvajnik vyavastha, suraksha aur aam logon ki aavajahi men badha ka havala dete hue ise nirdharit pradarshan sthal banae rakhne par aapatti jataee.
Thank you for watching our video!
